reason: In the patched test fixture, BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.java:326-340 isValid() returns true if any stored code matches (`generatedKeys.stream().anyMatch(...)`). It never checks the expected next code and never removes or marks the used code. So `allCodesUsed()` and the cleanup at RecoveryAuthnCodesFormAuthenticator.java:85-91 can never trigger for federated users.
